name: lookup_symbols
description: Look up specific symbols (stocks, indexes, ETFs) by ticker. Use this for direct symbol lookup including market indexes like TVC:SPX, TVC:DJI, OMXSTO:OMXS30 that cannot be found via screening. Returns comprehensive data including ATH, 52-week highs/lows.

columns.description: Optional: specific columns to include. Default: name, close, change, volume, market_cap_basic, all_time_high, all_time_low, price_52_week_high, price_52_week_low.

symbols.description: Array of ticker symbols (e.g., ['TVC:SPX', 'NASDAQ:AAPL', 'OMXSTO:OMXS30']). Maximum 100 symbols.
